summary: Frontend-only smoke + feature test of iter-11 changes (text-edit bug fix, expanded font palette, TOC button). 13/14 automated assertions pass. The 1 failure is a test-script artifact, not a product bug. All three new features work end-to-end on the live preview URL.

issues: The newly-inserted TOC block (y=118px) visually overlaps the auto-created 'Double-click to edit' placeholder text block above it (y~40). Not a functional bug — user can drag the TOC where they want — but worth a small y-offset bump or auto-removal of the empty starter block when TOC is inserted.

action_items: Consider: when a chapter heading sits on the very last page (back cover), the TOC entry shows no page number due to back-cover suppression rule. Verified intentional but may surprise users in a tiny 3-page chapter book.
Cosmetic: TOC block is inserted at y = margin+80 and visually overlaps the canvas's default 'Double-click to edit' placeholder. Consider placing it lower or clearing empty placeholders on insert.
critical_code_review_comments: CanvasBlock.jsx: mouseup-with-threshold (4px) correctly bypasses react-rnd's click swallowing. Single click enters edit mode on first try when block is already selected — UX is now snappy. Code is clean.

fonts.js: 31 fonts grouped into 5 categories — matches the ~28 promise. Google Fonts @import in index.css covers every Google-hosted family; system fonts (Georgia/Times/Helvetica/Courier) gracefully fall back to OS.

Editor.jsx addTocBlock: uses textContent extraction from HTML — safe against bold/italic markup inside chapter titles. Page-number rule mirrors the canvas page-number rule (start offset + back-cover suppression) — consistent.
Editor.jsx is now 1236 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting (toolbar / canvas / handlers / TOC builder) into smaller modules to ease future maintenance.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_TOC_Run book in the library via the New Book modal during testing. Safe to leave or delete via the Dashboard trash icon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bindery is an unauthenticated book editor. To reach the editor, click 'New Book', fill the title in the modal (placeholder 'The Treasure Map…') and click 'Begin writing' — direct click on a card also works for existing books. Key data-testids: add-text-button, add-chapter-button, add-toc-button, chapter-book-switch, page-number-switch, font-family-trigger, font-option-<FontName>, page-number-font-trigger, page-number-font-<FontName>, page-thumbnail-<idx>, save-button, export-pdf-button, text-block-content-<blockId>. The 'click-to-edit' fix lives in CanvasBlock.jsx via onMouseDown+onMouseUp with a 4px movement threshold (NOT onClick — react-rnd swallows clicks). The drag-no-edit script assertion in iteration_11 falsely failed because the script clicked the block (entering edit mode) before the drag — implementation is correct, behaviour verified visually.

rca of the issue: n/a — no critical bugs found. The drag_no_edit assertion's failure is a test-setup issue (block was already in edit mode pre-drag), not a regression. Visual inspection confirmed drag works without triggering edit because of the 4px movement threshold in CanvasBlock.jsx onMouseUp handler combined with Rnd's disableDragging while editing.
